title: Enshrouded – Serverdetails
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a NEW complete UI concept using the supplied image ONLY as the accepted style reference, not as the screen to copy unchanged. Same Sturmklingen Dunkle Schmiede identity: charcoal stone, forged dark steel, fine antique-gold edges, pale ivory readable text, gold primary buttons, dark steel secondary buttons. Preserve the sword crest/wordmark treatment and the reference's serif headings plus clean humanist sans-serif controls. No modern blue SaaS styling, no charts, no fake metrics, no new product areas.
This is a compact private PHP-rendered family server-centre for Enshrouded and ASKA, not a marketing page or game HUD. Concept data below are fictional states, not live observations. No addresses, secrets, app passwords or real personal data.
Output a flat professional design sheet with large DESKTOP UI on the left and readable MOBILE UI on the right, both complete, preferably generous landscape 2048x1536. SCREEN: Enshrouded server detail, family view. Both viewports contain the same information.
Header: STURMKLINGEN. A restrained back link "Serverzentrale". Do NOT show the administrator-only Zugänge link in this family view.
Page heading exactly "Enshrouded". A shallow landscape banner with the reference's misty stone castle artwork, much shorter than the dashboard game image so the controls remain prominent on mobile.
Below, a plain readable status/control region with exact lines "Server läuft" and "Spielbereitschaft unbekannt". A running process must NOT be depicted as ready to join. Use a neutral readiness mark and no "Bereit" success claim. Buttons "Starten" (visibly disabled because already running) and "Stoppen" (enabled, reference dark steel / antique-gold border). Stop remains a deliberate secondary action.
A compact join-information section headed "Beitreten": label "Beitrittsadresse", value "Noch nicht verfügbar", button "Kopieren" visibly disabled while the address is missing. No invented IP or join code. Omit player counts, logs, resources, admin tools and extra features. The whole layout including join section is visible in both viewports. No explanatory extra paragraphs.

title: Wichtige Zustände
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Use supplied image ONLY as accepted Sturmklingen Dunkle Schmiede style reference: same charcoal stone, forged steel, restrained antique gold, ivory serif headings and clean sans-serif controls.
Create a fresh large readable DESIGN STATE SHEET, preferably 2048x1536, with FOUR clearly separated UI state examples in a 2x2 arrangement. These are component/state references for the small server app, not four competing dashboards. Keep text large, crisp, aligned and readable. No fake metric charts, no decorative badges, no lore, no unrelated areas, no watermark. No big scenic backgrounds in the state examples.
Top left: Enshrouded action in progress. Game heading "Enshrouded". Exact status "Start läuft …"; helper "Der Start wird geprüft."; disabled buttons "Starten" and "Stoppen". Use a small restrained loading indicator, no confirmed green success or ready claim.
Top right: Enshrouded operation outcome unknown after a lost response. Heading "Enshrouded". Exact status "Ausgang unklar"; helper "Der Ausgang der Aktion ist noch nicht bestätigt."; both "Starten" and "Stoppen" clearly disabled; one secondary safe read-only button "Status prüfen". Bottom left: known failed start, with separately confirmed stopped observation. Heading "ASKA". Exact status "Start fehlgeschlagen"; helper "Server gestoppt"; gold enabled "Starten", disabled "Stoppen". No running/ready indication.
Bottom right: full-page access-denied message component. Exact heading "Zugriff gesperrt"; exact body "Bitte wende dich an die Verwaltung.". Show no game cards, start/stop controls or admin link in this denied state. Clean readable centered message in the same stone/steel design.
